assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq X Plus), mouse quadriceps
sample_inclusion: QUAD muscle of D-gal-treated male C57BL/6J mice injected with PBS or MSCs, n = 4 per arm (S3.2.p1, FIG2 legend, Figure S3 legend)
primary_estimand: Effect of intramuscular MSC injection vs PBS on quadriceps gene expression in D-galactose-induced muscle atrophy (S3.2.p1). Not an exercise effect: treadmill running is only an outcome test given to all mice (S2.4.p1).
planned_contrasts: D-gal+MSCs vs D-gal+PBS, QUAD (S3.2.p1; paper: 960 DEGs, 525 up / 435 down)
NAD+-MSCs vs MSCs, cultured human MSCs (S3.5.p1, FIG5; not deposited in GSE304351)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.7.p1 (DESeq2 named, DEG cutoff not given); S2.16.p1 p < 0.05 refers to GraphPad tests

paper_results.QUAD MSC vs PBS: 960 DEGs (525 up, 435 down); up enriched in fatty-acid degradation, OXPHOS, PPAR

exercise_role: Exhaustive treadmill run (S2.4.p1) used once as a performance readout one week after the last injection, in every group; no exercise intervention or exercise-vs-sedentary arm
